description: Replace the site's pages with an existing website's (Squarespace, Wix, or anything with a sitemap), word for word, at the same paths, with its images copied across. Runs in the background for a minute or two: poll get_site until `job` is null, or read its error.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: import_site
title: Move a website in
